blocks.text: The Guru recognizes Kapura's conduct for what it was and moves on toward Sabo, leaving behind those who had failed him and leaning instead into the strength of new allies. (24.1–2)
At Talwandi, Dalla steps forward and says plainly that if the Guru's road is theirs, they will not separate from him but join their service and households to his cause. (3–4)

Money, animals, langar, and household support are offered in a more stable way here, and Dalla becomes one of the principal figures in the transition from wandering danger toward renewed consolidation. (5–6)
